visible_item.prompt: The bus arrived at 8:20. Maya started waiting at 8:00 and was still waiting then. Complete the sentence using the verb in brackets: Maya ___ for twenty minutes when the bus arrived. (wait)
visible_item.target_answer: Maya had been waiting for twenty minutes when the bus arrived.
